This release renames the tool to **pdf-toolkit**, replaces the flag-based
command line with subcommands, and splits the source into a Cargo workspace.
The crate boundaries were drawn to make room for more commands in one
application.

**The JSON on stdout is unchanged.** Only the way the tool is invoked has
changed, so a caller that already parses the output needs to update how it
spawns the binary and nothing else.

## Added

- **`vector`** — recovers the CAD geometry a drawing is made of by interpreting
  the PDF's content streams, classifies every page, and exports georeferenced
  GeoJSON. A survey sheet's printed turning-point table places it on its own,
  with the residual reported in metres; where a sheet prints none, pass two or
  more `--georeference local_x,local_y,longitude,latitude`. Every page yields
  GeoJSON whether or not it could be placed, and `crs` says which frame it is
  in. This command loads no native library and spawns no subprocess.
- **`docs/json-api.md`** — the output contract, field by field, for all six
  commands. It ships inside the release archive beside the binary, so a consumer
  that unpacks the tarball has the reference it needs. Examples in it are copied
  from real runs.

## Changed

- **Breaking — the binary is now `pdf-toolkit`.** The archive, the executable
  and the crate all follow.
- **Breaking — subcommands replace mode flags.** `--format pdf|png` splits into
  two commands, because merging and scaling never applied to the same output:

  | before | now |
  |---|---|
  | `--input X --page-count` | `inspect X` |
  | `--input X --format pdf` | `cut X` |
  | `--input X --format pdf --concat` | `cut X --concat` |
  | `--input X --format png --scale 2` | `render X --scale 2` |
  | `--input X --extract` | `text X` |
  | `--input X --extract-structured` | `structured X` |

  The input is now the first positional argument. `--pages`/`-p` (alias
  `--page`), `--output`/`-o`, `--concat`/`-c`, `--scale`/`-s`,
  `--scale-width-px` and `--structured-format` keep their names and meanings on
  the commands they apply to.
- Options that were meaningful in one mode and an error in another no longer
  exist on the command they did not apply to. `--concat` with PNG output,
  `--scale` with PDF output, and any sizing option with text extraction were
  run-time errors; they are now rejected while parsing, with a usage message.
- The source is a Cargo workspace of six crates — `pdf-core`, `pdf-render`,
  `pdf-text`, `pdf-inspect`, `pdf-pages` and `pdf-toolkit`. `pdf-toolkit`
  re-exports the whole API, so embedding it is a single import as before.

## Fixed

- A run in which every page was skipped printed nothing on stderr, leaving the
  reason visible only to a caller that parsed the `errors` object. Warnings are
  now reported whether or not any page succeeded.

## Migration

```diff
-pdf_cutter --input doc.pdf --page-count
+pdf-toolkit inspect doc.pdf

-pdf_cutter --input doc.pdf --format pdf --pages 1-3 --output out
+pdf-toolkit cut doc.pdf --pages 1-3 --output out

-pdf_cutter --input doc.pdf --format png --scale-width-px 1400 --output out
+pdf-toolkit render doc.pdf --scale-width-px 1400 --output out

-pdf_cutter --input doc.pdf --extract --concat --output out
+pdf-toolkit text doc.pdf --concat --output out

-pdf_cutter --input doc.pdf --extract-structured --structured-format markdown
+pdf-toolkit structured doc.pdf --structured-format markdown
```
